title: Agent Status
description: Status file for container agents. Written to .worktrees/.status/agent{N}.json by each agent and read by the orchestrator.

autonomy_level.description: The rules-of-engagement level (L1-L4) this agent runs at, per orchestrate/autonomy-levels.md — chosen at the setup flow and inherited from its track (a severity/critical issue is capped at L3). Cache mirror for the monitor/display; the next-issue state file's autonomy_level is authoritative for the run.

issue.description: Issue number the agent is working on.

branch.description: Git branch the agent is working on.

commits.description: Number of commits since branch creation.

started.description: ISO datetime when the agent started this task.

last_activity.description: ISO datetime of last status update.

checkpoint.description: Agent's last checkpoint from the next-issue pipeline state.
